type.description: It indicates the types of content that can be defined within the slot which includes `image`, `text`, `form`, `product-listing`, `category-navigation`, `product-box`, `buy-box`, `sidebar-filter`, etc.

slot.description: Key-value pair to configure which element to be shown in which slot.

locked.description: When locked, then CMS slot config element cannot be configured.

config.description: Specifies detailed information about how the component is to be rendered.

customFields.description: Additional fields that offer a possibility to add own fields for the different program-areas.

data.description: Each cms slot (element) has a config that has values defined in the admin. When cms loads, each Resolver class adds the resolved config data to this value.

blockId.description: Unique identity of CMS block where slot is defined.

translated.description: Contains the translations of all translated fields.

VersionId.description: Unique identity of CMS slot's version.
